provenance.method: Review bounded source morphology and paragraph identifiers against the current Typewriter surface inventory. Admit verified in-scope identities after independent POS and sense review; hold only evidenced identity, POS, sense, or collision blockers. Corpus frequency, generality, writer usefulness, and relation counts do not determine lexical eligibility.

source.name: NIKL Written Corpus 2025 local reference snapshot

index.sample_policy: one paragraph when paragraph ordinal modulo 20 is zero, within each source-ordered document

typewriter_surface.normalization: Unicode NFC plus surrounding whitespace trim, matching runtime search input

selection.sample_policy: one paragraph when paragraph ordinal modulo 20 is zero, within each source-ordered document
selection.selection_rationale: Source-count ordering sets a bounded review queue. It is not an admission ranking; each disposition follows separate lexical identity, POS, sense, and coverage review.

extraction_error_classes: one-best morphology can misclassify unknown or context-ambiguous forms
compound segmentation can surface morphemes that still need lexical-boundary review
POS and lemma confidence have no calibrated score in this pilot
